detectPatterns: redesign|restyle|revamp|re-do|redo this|upgrade this|polish this|make this premium|make this look|not look like ai|with a photo|with this photo|using a photo|using this photo|attached photo|attached image|this screenshot|from the screenshot|with the image
expansion: High-quality redesign of existing UI in this project — preserve routes, data flow, and core copy intent; upgrade typography hierarchy, semantic color tokens, spacing, material (photo as intentional anchor not wallpaper), one interaction moment; edit the real files, do not spawn a duplicate template page
locateTarget: Find the page or component the user means — open file, route, @-mention, or grep project for matching path/component name
If ambiguous, check app router (app/, pages/, src/routes/), index.html, or the file they have focused — ask only when two equally likely targets
Read the current implementation fully before changing anything
photoHandling: User attached image → save or reference under project public/, assets/, or .premiumref/assets/ with a stable local path
User said 'with a photo' but none attached → search project for images (public/, assets/, static/, *.webp, *.jpg) or ask once for path
Photo is visual anchor — hero, card media, avatar, or section background in ONE bounded zone — not full-page blur wallpaper
Use object-fit, aspect-ratio, and crop with intent; add alt text; prefer local paths over hotlinked URLs
preserve: Same URL/route and primary user job after redesign
Existing content structure unless user asked to rewrite copy
Working forms, links, and navigation — upgrade craft, don't break behavior
upgrade: Typographic hierarchy — display/price/headline vs quiet meta
Spacing and alignment — senior product rhythm, not tighter template padding
One material moment — mesh band, photo frame, soft elevation — tied to the photo if provided
One meaningful micro-interaction (hover, toggle, preview) where appropriate
Remove template slop — purple blobs, icon grids, cursor stacks, em-dash copy
